
```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

col_pla_env = c("#7B9DBB", "#EFB04B")
col_4_risk_type = c("#ECD1D1", "#ABD7EC", "#FFDD8E", "#A8D3A0")

```


```{r}

data <- read_csv("link_type_num.csv")

data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(neg, ns, pos), names_to = "association", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(group, risk, habitat) %>%
  mutate(relative_value = value / sum(value)) %>% 
  ungroup()

data_environment <- data_long %>% filter(habitat == "Environment")
data_plastisphere <- data_long %>% filter(habitat == "Plastisphere")

```


```{r}
#  bulk water
p1 <- ggplot(data_environment, aes(x = 2, y = relative_value, fill = association)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#EB7E60", "#C6EAE3", "#8FB4DC"),
                     limits = c("pos", "ns", "neg"))+
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(title = "Habitat: Environment", fill = "Association") +
  facet_grid(group ~ risk) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))

p1

```



```{r}

#  Plastisphere 
p2 <- ggplot(data_plastisphere, aes(x = 2, y = relative_value, fill = association)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#EB7E60", "#C6EAE3", "#8FB4DC"),
                     limits = c("pos", "ns", "neg"))+
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  labs(title = "Habitat: Plastisphere", fill = "Association") +
  facet_grid(group ~ risk) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))


p2

```


```{r}
# fig b
library(ggprism)
library(reshape2)

data <- read.csv("link_type_num.csv")
data <- data %>%
  mutate(num_of_negaitive_links = neg,
         num_of_positive_links = pos)

data2 <- melt(data, id.vars = c("group", "risk", "neg", "ns", "pos", "habitat"))
order_list <- c("Pathogenic_bacteria", "Pathogenic_fungi","Toxic_algae", "ARGs")
data2$risk <- factor(data2$risk, levels = order_list)

p4b <- data2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = risk,y = ifelse(habitat=="Plastisphere",-value, value), fill = group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "white")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_4_risk_type) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),limits=c(-300, 300))+
  annotate("rect", ymin = 0, ymax = 300, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#7B9DBB")+ 
  annotate("rect", ymin = -300, ymax = 0, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#EFB04B")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p4b
```


```{r}
# fig c
library(ggprism)
library(reshape2)

data <- read.csv("link_type_num.csv")

data2 <- data %>%
  mutate(Proportion_of_negaitive_links = neg/(pos+ns+neg), 
         Proportion_of_positive_links = pos/(pos+ns+neg))

data2 <- melt(data2, id.vars = c("group", "risk", "neg", "pos", "ns", "habitat"))
order_list <- c("Pathogenic_bacteria", "Pathogenic_fungi","Toxic_algae", "ARGs")
data2$risk <- factor(data2$risk, levels = order_list)


p4c <- data2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = risk,y = ifelse(habitat=="Plastisphere",-value, value), fill = group)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "white")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_4_risk_type) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),limits=c(-1.4, 1.4))+
  annotate("rect", ymin = 0, ymax = 1.4, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#7B9DBB")+ 
  annotate("rect", ymin = -1.4, ymax = 0, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#EFB04B")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p4c

```


```{r}
# fig d
data <- read_csv("link_type_num.csv")

data_summed <- data %>%
  group_by(habitat, risk) %>%
  summarise(pos_sum = sum(pos, na.rm = TRUE), neg_sum = sum(neg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") 

data_summed <- data_summed %>%
  mutate(pos_neg_ratio = ifelse(neg_sum == 0, NA, pos_sum / neg_sum)) 

risk_levels <- c("Pathogenic_bacteria", "Pathogenic_fungi", "Toxic_algae", "ARGs")
data_summed$risk <- factor(data_summed$risk, levels = risk_levels)

p4d <- ggplot(data_summed, aes(x = risk, y = pos_neg_ratio, fill = habitat)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_pla_env) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 1.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#ECD1D1")+ 
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1.5, xmax = 2.5,  ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#ABD7EC")+
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2.5, xmax = 3.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#FFDD8E")+
    annotate("rect", xmin = 3.5, xmax =4.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,fill="#A8D3A0")+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
p4d

```


```{r}
library(cowplot)
p4bcd <- plot_grid(p4b,p4c, p4d, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1,1,1))
p4bcd

ggsave(plot = p4bcd, "num&proportion_pos_neg_link.pdf", width = 240, height = 66, units = c("mm"))

```
